evaluation_definition: For attack family A, form a validation evaluation set containing all benign rows from that split plus attack rows belonging to A.
family_set_policy: Do not add/drop attack families because of Stage23 results.
low_support_policy: Families with fewer than 100 validation attacks are listed descriptively but excluded from inferential interpretation.
source_alignment: Use day_id + original_row_index to recover development attack family labels from authorized Feb14-Feb28 source labels or existing repository attack-category infrastructure.
